```{r, include = FALSE}
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"

```

```{r setup}
library(hyperion)
library(hyperion.tables)

project_dir <- system.file("extdata", "scm-001", package = "hyperion.tables")
options(hyperion.config_dir = project_dir)
scm <- read_scm(
  file.path(project_dir, "model", "nonmem", "PK", "scm", "scm-001scm.toml")
)
```

## SCM Lineage

```{r}
lineage <- get_scm_lineage(scm)

lineage
```

## Base SCM Summary Table

```{r}
lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(scm_summary_spec()) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Choosing Rounds

Use the `rounds` argument to control which rounds appear. Name the rounds
to show, here the first forward round (The base, working full and reduced covariate models always show):

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(rounds = NULL)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Marking the Selected Candidates

Use the `selected` argument to show which covariate candidate was most significant in each round, if applicable.
It takes `ScmSelectedOptions()`, which has multiple flags. The Round Result
column is there by default; `column = FALSE` leaves it out:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  rounds = "forward_round1",
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(column = FALSE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

`bold = TRUE` renders the selected covariate candidate's row in bold:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  rounds = "forward_round1",
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(bold = TRUE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

The same specifications on the full table:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(bold = TRUE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Selected Candidates Only

`selected_only = TRUE` leaves out the covariate candidates the rounds did not select.
The steps that remain are grouped under "Forward" and "Backward":

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(selected_only = TRUE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Rounds by Direction

`rounds` also takes a direction, `"forward"` or `"backward"`, for every
round that ran in it:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(rounds = "backward")

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Milestones Only

`rounds = NA` shows no round at all, only the base, working full and
reduced covariate models:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(rounds = NA)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Descriptions

The Description column shows what each fit added or dropped.
`show_all_covariates = TRUE` adds all of the covariates a model has:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  show_all_covariates = TRUE,
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(bold = TRUE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

With `selected_only = TRUE`, the descriptions show the model growing and
shrinking step by step:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  show_all_covariates = TRUE,
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(selected_only = TRUE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Table Title

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  title = "Forward Selection",
  rounds = "forward",
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(selected_only = TRUE)
)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```

## Summary Table Modifiers

An SCM summary spec is a `SummarySpec`, so summary table modifiers
apply to it:

```{r}
spec <- scm_summary_spec(
  title = "Covariate Search",
  selected = ScmSelectedOptions(selected_only = TRUE)
) |>
  set_spec_columns("description", "ofv", "dofv", "pvalue") |>
  set_spec_pvalue(scientific = TRUE)

lineage |>
  apply_summary_spec(spec) |>
  make_summary_table() |>
  render_to_image()
```
